answer: Farm heads are worthless until their earnings merge toward one wallet -- value drifts together like sand piling into a dune. Tag every reward with a lineage relic naming its earning identity; when tagged value from many identities converges at a single sink, the ledger fires one simultaneous pulse of unpredictable proof-tasks across all contributing heads, answered within seconds. A lone operator cannot clear dozens at once, so cash-out itself becomes the trap: pass the pulse, or the merged funds burn. Bigger farm, bigger fire.
